1408.author: agent-ci-infra-bot[bot]
1408.body:
The session column treated every timestamp under 24 hours old as "today", so a Session used yesterday at 22:00 and one used at 22:00 today both read `22:00`. Two identical clock-time branches also contradicted the function's comment.

## What changed
`stamp()` now compares local calendar dates, not elapsed hours. Same date keeps `HH:MM`; one day back reads `TEXT.workspace.yesterday`; 2–6 days use `daysAgo(n)`; 7+ use `weeksAgo(floor(n/7))`. Day indexes use local date components normalized to UTC, so DST cannot shift the count. The duplicated `days < 1` branch is gone.

The Issue assumed `昨天` existed, but it did not; because `Text = typeof ZH` requires parity, `workspace.yesterday` was added to both `zh.ts` and `en.ts`. The existing sidebar-extra date test was rewritten with deterministic calendar-day fixtures, with new cases for today, yesterday, day/week boundaries, invalid input, and the yesterday-22:00 render.

`SessionBar` is deliberately unchanged: it is outside this Issue's Sidebar scope, and its header describes the Session just opened, where the day is implicit. Its unconditional `HH:MM` is the same family of misreading, left as a possible follow-up.

## Validation
- `pnpm --filter @sciencediscovery/desktop typecheck` — exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @sciencediscovery/desktop test` — 1505 tests / 137 suites: 1505 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped.
- The old `stamp()` failed 4 new assertions, e.g. `expected '昨天', actual '22:00'`; all pass now.
- Rendered the real Sidebar/styles in Chromium (1000×700, DPR 2).

Before: `22:00`; after: `昨天`, `3天前`, `1周前`.
![Before](https://agent-ci-infra-bot.llmbots.co/pr-media/d5f97eeed475f90943601e2b789f3259847c8d8f2085fd2ab6a6b820c23f9c68)
![After](https://agent-ci-infra-bot.llmbots.co/pr-media/026e1fda7084655fefc05e01d8c2e17b64c5632ed6c76fb38eb20753ab9626cb)

1409.author: agent-ci-infra-bot[bot]
1409.body:
Issue #1397: `readNumber()` collapsed empty and unparsable text into `undefined`; `maxTokens` became `null` ("no cap") and depth/nodes accepted `0` despite `min={1}`. Chromium reports `1e999` in `<input type=number>` as `value=""` with `validity.badInput=true`, so this revision treats that as refused, not empty.

## What changed
- Each field keeps its text and invalid flag. Empty with `badInput=false` is the only `null` path for `maxTokens`; anything else must be a finite safe integer >= 1, so `0`, negatives, fractions and `1e999` are refused; depth/nodes also refuse empty.
- A refused field keeps its text, sets `aria-invalid`, gets a red border, shows a `role="alert"` note and blocks Save (no PUT); correcting it clears the error.
- Fields use `onInput`, not `onChange`: React ignores the unchanged `""` after `badInput`, so clearing a refused field would otherwise not reach the component. `maxTokens` keeps `min={1}`; en/zh strings added; no API/schema change.

## Validation
- Desktop tests: 1505 pass / 0 fail / 0 skipped; typecheck: pass.
- `idea-tree-settings.test.tsx` (8 tests): original 3 pass / 5 fail; previous candidate 7 pass / 1 fail (the badInput case); final 8 pass.
- Real browser (Playwright/Chromium, component with stub client): 18/18 checks. `1e999` in Token limit -> `badInput=true`, `aria-invalid=true`, alert shown, Save disabled, 0 PUTs; clear -> Save enabled; 4096 -> PUT `maxTokens:4096`; empty -> PUT `maxTokens:null`; depth `0` refused, no PUT; depth `1e999` refused; depth `7` -> PUT `maxDepth:7`. Typed text stays visible.

## E2E user journeys
BLOCKED: `ci:ut`/`ci:st`/`ci:e2e` stop at `BUBBLEWRAP_UNAVAILABLE` (no bwrap, exit 127, not root). Planned/executed: UT 8403/0, ST 69/0, mocked E2E 193/0. No app journey ran; the harness covers the real component and browser events.

## Release
Release category: release:fix
User impact: invalid numbers are refused visibly instead of saved as "no cap" or 0.
Compatibility and migration: none.

Closes #1397

1411.author: agent-ci-infra-bot[bot]
1411.body:
Settings › Timeouts wrote every keystroke into the draft, so `0` — the first digit of `0.5` — stored a real `0`, the meaning of 不限. `unlimited = current[field] === 0` then disabled and emptied the box being typed in: sub-second values could not be entered, and leaving the field committed the limit to unlimited. Confirmed on 645dc7ba from `setMilliseconds` (l.113) and the `unlimited` binding (l.143), and reproduced in Chromium: typing `0` left an empty disabled field and PUT `gatewayIdleTimeoutMs: 0`.

## What changes
- A keystroke now only edits that field's text (state plus ref); it never writes to the draft.
- Leaving the field (or Enter) validates and writes. `0` and values below 0.001 s are refused with an inline invalid-number message and stay on screen; they no longer become 不限.
- Only the 不限 switch writes 0; its `0` / `60_000` fallback is unchanged and switching drops half-typed text.
- Storage semantics are unchanged: a commit is still `Math.round(seconds * 1000)` (0.5 → 500 ms, 0.001 → 1 ms), and a refused PUT still falls back to the server value.

## Validation
- UT: 1505 tests, 1505 pass, 0 fail (5 new cases in `tests/timeouts-settings.test.tsx`); typecheck clean.
- Desktop mocked E2E, 超时 pane: 4 passed, including a new case that types `0` (still enabled, no PUT), continues `.5`, and sees `gatewayIdleTimeoutMs: 500`. Stashed at 645dc7ba the new E2E case fails and 2 of the 5 unit cases fail (`disabled` true after typing 0).
- `check-e2e-meta.mjs`: 129 specs, 0 errors; `node --test scripts/*.test.mjs`: 122/122, boundaries OK.
- `pnpm ci:ut` and `pnpm ci:e2e` are BLOCKED here: preflight reports `BUBBLEWRAP_UNAVAILABLE`; the desktop browser suite ran directly instead.

## Remaining risk
Only the 超时 pane changes. In a partial full-suite run, one unrelated timing-sensitive toast case failed identically with these changes stashed, so it is pre-existing.

Release category: release:fix

Closes #1396

1417.author: agent-ci-infra-bot[bot]
1417.body:
**Problem.** 设置 › 网络 sent `allowedDomains: []` and blanked the draft whenever the mode left 域名白名单, though `services/api/src/store/sandbox-network.ts` forbids domains only for `open`; the write's refetch also dropped unsaved text.

**Fix.** `choose()` decides per target mode: 开放网络 keeps its confirmation and still sends `allowedDomains: []`; 无网络 writes `{ mode: "none" }` with the saved list untouched and parks the box's text, unsaved edits included. The park is bound to its press (applied only to a read answering with the parked mode, cleared by writes) so a failed refetch cannot leave stale text for a later 保存. A refused press restores the pill and keeps the text. 保存 stays the only domain write; server rules and `apps/web` untouched.

**Tests.** `apps/desktop/tests/network-mode-allowlist.test.tsx` (7 cases, PUT bodies): 无网络 sends the saved hosts unchanged, no empty-list hint; unsaved text survives the round trip and 保存 writes it; a failed refetch after 无网络 leaves a later 保存's list in the box, not the abandoned text; a refused 无网络 write keeps the typed list, shows the error and stays saveable; 域名白名单 only stages; 开放网络 clears. The last two fail on the old code (5/7); 7/7 now.

## Validation
- `pnpm --filter @sciencediscovery/desktop test`: 1507 passed / 0 failed (136 suites); typecheck clean; API store test 11; catalog check OK.
- `pnpm ci:ut` cannot run here: preflight stops it with BUBBLEWRAP_UNAVAILABLE (`bwrap` cannot create a user namespace; no root) — UT 8410/0, ST 69/0, E2E 193/0 planned/executed; judged from the Actions run.

## E2E user journeys
Desktop mocked `shell-interactions.spec.ts` (includes 设置 › 沙箱网络 → 无网络): 10/10 passed; one earlier run hit the known fake-clock toast-lifetime check under load; it passes alone and on rerun.

## Release
`release:fix`. User impact: 无网络 keeps the allowlist and unsaved text; only 开放网络 clears it. Remaining risk: `apps/web/src/RuntimeControls.tsx` (`setMode`) has the same destructive `none` behaviour and is unchanged here.
